naslov: Suns take on the Magic on 4-game skid
tekst:
Orlando Magic (2-5, 12th in the Eastern Conference) vs. Phoenix Suns (1-5, 12th in the Western Conference)
              Phoenix; Thursday, 9 p.m. EST
              LINE: Suns -1.5; over/under is 224.5
              BOTTOM LINE: Phoenix aims to end its four-game skid when the Suns take on Orlando.
              Phoenix went 45-37 overall a season ago while going 25-16 at home. The Suns averaged 19.9 points off of turnovers, 16.4 second-chance points and 34.7 bench points last season.
              Orlando finished 45-37 overall with a 19-21 record on the road a season ago. The Magic gave up 115.1 points per game while committing 21.0 fouls last season.
              INJURIES: Suns: Mark Williams: out (shoulder), Rasheer Fleming: day to day (ankle), Jordan Goodwin: day to day (calf).
              Magic: Paolo Banchero: out (ankle), Jonathan Isaac: out (knee), Izaiyah Nelson: out (ankle), Noah Penda: out (hamstring), Jalen Suggs: out (knee).
